info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Meetings Meetings Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Meeting Status Retrieval API provides access to the current status of meetings within the system. Users can utilize this endpoint to obtain up-to-date information regarding the scheduling and participant statuses of various meetings. This API is particularly beneficial for administrators and management personnel who need to monitor meeting engagements efficiently. By leveraging this resource, developers can integrate meeting status information into their applications or dashboards, enhancing their operational workflows.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of meetings.
get.description: This API endpoint allows users to fetch the current statuses of all meetings. It provides essential information such as ongoing meetings, scheduled meetings, and any cancellations. This is useful for users to check meeting availability and manage their schedules effectively.
